content.text:
I read the brief against the release line by line. Summary of what I found:

**Two errors, both the same one:** the ~$8,700M free cash flow figure is footnoted in the release as *second-quarter **YTD** 2026* (and as an estimate as of July 15). The brief presents it twice as a quarterly figure — once in "Results" ("for Q2 2026") and again in "Capital and balance sheet" ("for the second quarter of 2026"). The $6,214M comparative carries the same period error.

**One gap:** worldwide operational growth of 5.6% and adjusted operational growth of 5.7% never appear — the brief gives operational growth only at the segment level.

**One nuance worth flagging to the analyst (not an error):** for both segments the brief cites *operational* growth (6.8% / 3.6%) in place of the *reported* growth (7.8% / 4.5%). The dollar figures are right and the non-GAAP labels are correct, so nothing is misstated, but a reader gets no reported-basis segment growth. Everything else — headline sales, both EPS lines, both guidance raises, the STELARA 760bps drag, the product and announcement items — checks out.

facts.evidence: Q2 2026 reported sales were $25.3 billion, representing a 6.6% increase year-over-year.
Q2 2026 reported diluted EPS was $2.27, a 0.9% decrease from the prior year.
Non-GAAP adjusted EPS for Q2 2026 was $2.90, up 4.7% from the prior year.

Innovative Medicine reported Q2 2026 sales of $16.4 billion, with operational sales growth of 6.8% excluding translational currency. (Sales figure correctly rounded from $16,384M; the growth rate given is operational, correctly labeled, rather than the 7.8% reported growth.)
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was increased by $0.13 to a midpoint of $11.68, representing 8.2% growth.
The company increased its full-year 2026 estimated reported sales guidance to a midpoint of $101.1 billion, or 7.3% growth.

Non-GAAP free cash flow for Q2 2026 was approximately $8.7 billion, compared to $6.2 billion in the prior year. / Non-GAAP free cash flow for the second quarter of 2026 was estimated at approximately $8.7 billion.

MedTech reported Q2 2026 sales of $8.9 billion, with operational sales growth of 3.6% excluding translational currency. (Sales figure correctly rounded from $8,926M; the growth rate given is operational, correctly labeled, rather than the 4.5% reported growth.)
Monitor the impact of STELARA, which negatively impacted Innovative Medicine operational growth by approximately 760 basis points in Q2 2026.

claims.note: Repeat of the period error: the ~$8,700M estimate is second-quarter year-to-date 2026, not the quarter alone.

claims.claim: The company announced an investment of more than $1 billion to strengthen U.S. Vision manufacturing in Jacksonville, Florida.
The company announced the acquisition of Firefly Bio, Inc. to expand its oncology pipeline.
STELARA negatively impacted Innovative Medicine operational growth by approximately 760 basis points in Q2 2026.
The release cites the planned separation of the Orthopaedics business as a risk factor.
TREMFYA was newly approved in the quarter for use in active psoriatic arthritis.
CAPLYTA was newly approved in the quarter for the prevention of relapse in schizophrenia.
